summary: Candidate 82024c3 independently reproduces and corrects the DSA metadata row-count mismatch on the recorded base. The narrow padding contract is verified, but the original two-node H20 CUDA/GLM-5.2 deployment remains unavailable and therefore is not claimed fully resolved.
remaining_counterexamples: The exact two-node H20 TP16/EP16/DP2 GLM-5.2-FP8 EAGLE deployment was not executable in this one-gfx950 environment.
CUDA FA3, DeepEP collectives, concurrent HTTP serving, and full-model semantic behavior remain unverified.
No GLM-5.2 or compatible draft-model weights were available to reproduce the reported end-to-end exception.
